facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that programmatic DOOH makes up over 30% of DOOH ad spending, a figure it presents without a stated source in this passage.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH makes up over 30% of DOOH ad spending and is forecasted to grow 18.8% year-over-year (YoY) in 2026.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that programmatic DOOH is forecast to grow 18.8% year-over-year in 2026, citing eMarketer.
facts.quote: with ad spending projected to climb [18.8%](https://forecasts-na1.emarketer.com/584b26021403070290f93a55/5f11e61dfd62d60758baa57c) YoY in 2026.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that programmatic DOOH is on track to reach $1.37 billion USD by 2027.
facts.quote: It’s currently on track to reach $1.37 billion USD by 2027.

facts.fact: StackAdapt cites Statista in saying programmatic DOOH accounts for 30% of the DOOH category's revenue.
facts.quote: As a result, programmatic DOOH now makes up [30%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1609972/programmatic-share-dooh-united-states/) of the category’s revenue

facts.fact: StackAdapt cites an OAAA study finding that 73% of US consumers view DOOH ads favourably, compared with 50% for television, 48% for social media, and 31% for print.
facts.quote: a study by the OAAA found that [73% of US consumers](https://www.emarketer.com/content/dooh-ads-drive-action-people-who-view-them) view DOOH ads favourably

facts.fact: StackAdapt cites a study finding that 51% of people who noticed a DOOH ad with directions to a nearby store visited the business, and 93% of those completed a purchase.
facts.unit: % of people who noticed the DOOH ad
facts.quote: who noticed a DOOH ad with directions to a nearby store visited the business (93% of whom completed a purchase).

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH (pDOOH) is defined as the automated buying, selling, and delivery of DOOH advertising through programmatic advertising platforms.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH (also known as pDOOH) refers to the automated buying, selling, and delivery of DOOH advertising through [programmatic advertising platforms]

facts.fact: StackAdapt says traditional OOH buying is primarily manual and upfront, while programmatic DOOH can be automated but also supports direct or guaranteed deals.
facts.quote: Buying method | Primarily manual, upfront | Can be automated but also supports direct or guaranteed deals when needed; also done in real time

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH provides access to digital screens in places such as big box stores, fitness centers, transit hubs, universities, workplaces, and EV charging stations.
facts.quote: such as big box stores, fitness centers, transit hubs, universities, workplaces, and

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH campaigns can include interactive elements such as QR codes and touchscreens.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH campaigns can include interactive elements like QR codes and touchscreens

facts.fact: The Large Format DOOH category consists of oversized digital billboards in public spaces such as highways, airports, and major city centres.
facts.quote: Oversized digital billboards in public spaces like highways, airports, and major city centres

facts.fact: The Place-Based DOOH category consists of venue-based digital screens in and around public spaces such as gyms, malls, gas stations, stadiums, and medical offices.
facts.quote: Venue-based digital screens found in and around public spaces like gyms, malls, gas stations, stadiums, and medical offices

facts.fact: The Transit DOOH category includes screens in airports, subway platforms, bus shelters, taxis, and rideshares.
facts.quote: Found in airports, subway platforms, bus shelters, taxis, and rideshares

facts.fact: The Point of Purchase DOOH category includes screens near store entrances, checkout aisles, and product displays.
facts.quote: Used near store entrances, checkout aisles, and product displays

facts.fact: Location-based targeting in programmatic DOOH lets campaigns run by country, region, DMA, city, or zip/postal code.
facts.quote: Target campaigns by country, region, DMA, city, or zip/postal code

facts.fact: Dynamic targeting in programmatic DOOH adjusts delivery based on real-time conditions such as weather, time of day, sports scores, or local events.
facts.quote: Adjust delivery based on real-time conditions such as weather, time of day, sports scores, or local events

facts.fact: Audience targeting in programmatic DOOH uses mobility and 3rd-party data through programmatic guaranteed deals to target screens that overindex for segments such as frequent travellers or soft drink buyers.
facts.quote: Use mobility and 3rd-party data through programmatic guaranteed deals to target screens that overindex for key segments

facts.fact: Footfall attribution uses mobile device IDs captured by location partners near DOOH placements to connect store visits to specific campaigns.
facts.quote: uses mobile device IDs captured by location partners near DOOH placements to connect store visits back to specific campaigns

facts.fact: Brand lift studies measure changes in awareness, recall, consideration, or purchase intent by comparing a group exposed to DOOH ads with a control group.
facts.quote: by comparing a group exposed to DOOH ads with a control group

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, MOBSTA's DOOH campaign for Michael Kors Jewelry in Germany delivered 14 million impressions.
facts.quote: The campaign delivered **14 million impressions**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, MOBSTA's Michael Kors Jewelry DOOH campaign drove a 39% increase in brand lift in Berlin.
facts.quote: drove a **39% increase in brand lift in Berlin**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, MOBSTA's Michael Kors Jewelry DOOH campaign drove a 13% increase in brand lift in Hamburg.
facts.quote: **13% increase in brand lift in Hamburg**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Octopus Energy's DOOH campaign across six Spanish cities generated 3 million impressions.
facts.quote: The campaign generated**3 million impressions**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Octopus Energy's DOOH campaign with retargeting achieved a 1.34% average CTR.
facts.quote: **a 1.34% average CTR**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Octopus Energy's DOOH campaign with retargeting generated more than 1,000 conversions.
facts.quote: **more than 1,000 conversions**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Digital Willow's DOOH ads for Visit Isle of Man contributed to a 263% increase in search click volume.
facts.quote: contributed to a **263% increase in search click volume**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Somebody Digital's DOOH and multi-channel retargeting campaign for Ramsbury delivered 32.4 million impressions.
facts.quote: the campaign delivered **32.4 million impressions**

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's case study, Somebody Digital's Ramsbury campaign nearly doubled website traffic, a 99% increase.
facts.quote: **nearly doubled website traffic (+99%)**

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that typical programmatic DOOH CPMs range from $4 to $50.
facts.quote: Typical programmatic DOOH CPMs range from $4 to $50.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that DOOH inventory can be bought programmatically, with marketers bidding on digital screens through DSPs.
facts.quote: Yes. DOOH inventory can be bought programmatically.
